scope: R152 timing of the MLP SiLU activation with device events
duplication_evidence: mlp median 88.16 ms matches the R149 independent measurement (88.178 ms), so the span is right and only the count is multiplied
finding: The SiLU is only about a fifth of the 1.729 s mlp residual; roughly 1.4 s lies elsewhere in the mlp activation path.
new_suspicion: MiniMaxH3MLP.forward calls hidden.chunk(2, dim=-1), which returns non-contiguous views, and then runs F.silu(gate) * up on strided inputs over an FP32 [10448, 14336] buffer. Strided elementwise passes over a ~600 MB buffer, plus the separate multiply, are a plausible source of the remaining ~1.4 s and are numerically free to change as long as the per-element formula and evaluation order are preserved.
open: per-shape silu totals were not aggregated, so the 50 MLP calls are not yet separated from the ~54 adaLN calls
next: measure the chunk/mul path with a contiguous-narrow control to quantify the strided-access cost
